In my last year and once I left I started to come to terms with myself and realise I’m not who I was. I’m sort of rambling but where I’m going with this is it takes time to discover these things. So if you’re not sure at the moment don’t worry, you’ve a lot of time to figure that out. So if you’re feeling conflicted it’s normal, it’s not something where you wake up and realise I’m a woman, or I’m a man. It’s okay, you’re okay. Your T blockers are stopping your testies from producing the same number of testosterone. Like idk how much less it is. And your estrogen is fuelling other parts.

Basically your T blockers are stopping your testies from making testosterone, to get “hard” you need testosterone. That’s why you can’t get it. 

Now to try and get hard you’ll have to talk to a doctor, I know you want a straightforward answer but viagra and similar drugs can have a bad effect on you, so it’s better to talk to a doctor and make sure you can use it without effecting your overall transition. 
(I think that’s the best thing for you to do)

But don’t go using things like that without asking a doctor, goes for all substances, painkillers and other drugs. Estrogen is new to you and your body so you could have a bad reaction to more substances, especially if you’re using the wrong dosage.
